description: This dataset contains sediment radioisotope data collected from a specific event at a location with a latitude of approximately 21.365278 and a longitude of approximately -104.568333, at an elevation of 750 meters. The data includes measurements of depth, lead-210 (210Pb) concentrations, supported and unsupported 210Pb, cesium-137 (137Cs) concentrations, and their respective standard deviations. The measurements cover depths ranging from 0 to 0.275 meters, with 210Pb concentrations spanning from 0 to 147.1 Bq/kg and 137Cs concentrations up to 19.8 Bq/kg. Semantically, the dataset focuses on environmental measurements and spatial references, making it useful for environmental studies and sediment analysis. This data can be utilized for dating sediment layers, studying sediment accumulation rates, and understanding environmental changes over time. The dataset was collected on April 8, 2022.
